scenes.code:
total = 0
for n in range(1, 4):
    total = total + n
    print(n, total)
print("done")

steps.note: We create a box called total and put 0 in it.
n takes the values 1, 2, 3 one at a time.

scenes.narration: Let's run this loop line by line and watch every variable change as the program runs, step by step, so you can see exactly what the computer does.

scenes.title: Bubble sort, pass 1

steps.note: The biggest number bubbled to the end

scenes.narration: Bubble sort compares neighbours. If the left one is bigger, they swap. After one full pass, the largest value has bubbled to the end of the list.

scenes.title: How code runs
scenes.narration: Here's the big picture. You write code, a compiler translates it, the result is machine code, and the CPU runs it billions of times per second.
